segments.ja518:1.3: Bhayaṃ tamanveti sayaṃ abodhaṃ, nāgaṃ yathā paṇḍarakaṃ supaṇṇo [suvaṇṇo (ka.)].
segments.ja518:2.1: Yo guyhamantaṃ parirakkhaneyyaṃ, mohā naro saṃsati hāsamāno [bhāsamāno (pī.)];
segments.ja518:2.3: Taṃ bhinnamantaṃ bhayamanveti khippaṃ, nāgaṃ yathā paṇḍarakaṃ supaṇṇo.
segments.ja518:3.3: Sumitto ca asambuddhaṃ, sambuddhaṃ vā anattha vā.
segments.ja518:4.1: Vissāsamāpajjimahaṃ acelaṃ [acelo (sī. pī.)], samaṇo ayaṃ sammato bhāvitatto;
segments.ja518:4.3: Tassāhamakkhiṃ vivariṃ [vivaraṃ (sī.)] guyhamatthaṃ, atītamattho kapaṇaṃ [kapaṇo (pī.)] rudāmi.
segments.ja518:5.1: Tassāhaṃ paramaṃ [purimaṃ (sī.)] brahme guyhaṃ, vācañhi maṃ nāsakkhiṃ [nāsakkhi (pī.)] saṃyametuṃ;
segments.ja518:5.3: Tappakkhato hi bhayamāgataṃ mamaṃ, atītamattho kapaṇaṃ rudāmi.
segments.ja518:6.1: Yo ve naro suhadaṃ maññamāno, guyhamatthaṃ saṃsati dukkulīne;
segments.ja518:6.3: Dosā bhayā athavā rāgarattā [rāgaratto (sī. syā. pī.)], pallatthito [pallittho (pī.), pallattito (ka.)] bālo asaṃsayaṃ so.
segments.ja518:7.1: Tirokkhavāco asataṃ paviṭṭho, yo saṅgatīsu mudīreti vākyaṃ;
segments.ja518:7.3: Āsīviso dummukhotyāhu taṃ naraṃ, ārā ārā [ārā arā (pī.)] saṃyame tādisamhā.
segments.ja518:8.1: Annaṃ pānaṃ kāsika [kāsikaṃ (pī.)] candanañca, manāpitthiyo mālamucchādanañca;
segments.ja518:8.3: Ohāya gacchāmase sabbakāme, supaṇṇa pāṇūpagatāva tyamhā.
segments.ja518:9.1: Ko nīdha tiṇṇaṃ garahaṃ upeti, asmiṃdha loke pāṇabhū nāgarāja;
segments.ja518:9.3: Samaṇo supaṇṇo atha vā tvameva, kiṃ kāraṇā paṇḍarakaggahīto.
segments.ja518:10.1: Samaṇoti me sammatatto ahosi, piyo ca me manasā bhāvitatto;
segments.ja518:10.3: Tassāhamakkhiṃ vivariṃ guyhamatthaṃ, atītamattho kapaṇaṃ rudāmi.
segments.ja518:11.1: Na catthi satto amaro pathabyā, paññāvidhā natthi na ninditabbā;
segments.ja518:11.3: Saccena dhammena dhitiyā [dhiyā (sī. pī.)] damena, alabbhamabyāharatī naro idha.
segments.ja518:12.1: Mātāpitā paramā bandhavānaṃ, nāssa tatiyo anukampakatthi;
segments.ja518:12.3: Tesampi guyhaṃ paramaṃ na saṃse, mantassa bhedaṃ parisaṅkamāno.
segments.ja518:13.1: Mātāpitā bhaginī bhātaro ca, sahāyā vā yassa honti sapakkhā;
segments.ja518:13.3: Tesampi guyhaṃ paramaṃ na saṃse, mantassa bhedaṃ parisaṅkamāno.
segments.ja518:14.1: Bhariyā ce purisaṃ vajjā, komārī piyabhāṇinī;
segments.ja518:14.3: Puttarūpayasūpetā, ñātisaṅghapurakkhatā, tassāpi guyhaṃ paramaṃ na saṃse;
segments.ja518:15.1: Na guyhamatthaṃ [guyhatthaṃ (ka.)] vivareyya, rakkheyya naṃ yathā nidhiṃ;
segments.ja518:15.3: Na hi pātukato sādhu, guyho attho pajānatā.
segments.ja518:16.1: Thiyā guyhaṃ na saṃseyya, amittassa ca paṇḍito;
segments.ja518:16.3: Yo cāmisena saṃhīro, hadayattheno ca yo naro.
segments.ja518:18.3: Tāvanto tassa ubbegā, tasmā guyhaṃ na vissaje.
segments.ja518:19.1: Vivicca bhāseyya divā rahassaṃ, rattiṃ giraṃ nātivelaṃ pamuñce;
segments.ja518:19.3: Upassutikā hi suṇanti mantaṃ, tasmā manto khippamupeti bhedaṃ.
segments.ja518:20.1: Yathāpi assa [ayo (syā.), aya (ka.)] nagaraṃ mahantaṃ, advārakaṃ [āḷārakaṃ (pī.)] āyasaṃ bhaddasālaṃ;
segments.ja518:20.3: Samantakhātāparikhāupetaṃ, evampi me te idha guyhamantā.
segments.ja518:21.1: Ye guyhamantā avikiṇṇavācā, daḷhā sadatthesu narā dujivha [dujivhā (syā. pī.)];
segments.ja518:21.3: Ārā amittā byavajanti tehi, āsīvisā vā riva sattusaṅghā [sattasaṅghā (sī. syā.)].
segments.ja518:22.1: Hitvā gharaṃ pabbajito acelo, naggo muṇḍo carati ghāsahetu;
segments.ja518:22.3: Tamhi [tamhī (pī.)] nu kho vivariṃ guyhamatthaṃ, atthā ca dhammā ca apaggatamhā [apāgatamhā (sī.), apagatamhā (syā.), avāgatamhā (pī.)].
segments.ja518:23.1: Kathaṃkaro hoti supaṇṇarāja, kiṃsīlo kena vatena vattaṃ;
segments.ja518:23.3: Samaṇo caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni, kathaṃkaro saggamupeti ṭhānaṃ.
segments.ja518:24.1: Hiriyā titikkhāya damenupeto [damena khantiyā (sī. syā. pī.)], akkodhano pesuṇiyaṃ pahāya;
segments.ja518:24.3: Samaṇo caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni, evaṃkaro saggamupeti ṭhānaṃ.
segments.ja518:25.1: Mātāva puttaṃ taruṇaṃ tanujjaṃ [tanūjaṃ (sī.)], samphassatā [sampassa taṃ (sī. pī.)] sabbagattaṃ phareti;
segments.ja518:25.3: Evampi me tvaṃ pāturahu dijinda, mātāva puttaṃ anukampamāno.
segments.ja518:26.1: Handajja tvaṃ muñca [mucca (sī.)] vadhā dujivha, tayo hi puttā na hi añño atthi;
segments.ja518:26.3: Antevāsī dinnako atrajo ca, rajjassu [rajassu (sī. syā. pī.)] puttaññataro me ahosi.
segments.ja518:27.1: Icceva vākyaṃ visajjī supaṇṇo, bhumyaṃ patiṭṭhāya dijo dujivhaṃ;
segments.ja518:27.3: Muttajja tvaṃ sabbabhayātivatto, thalūdake hohi mayābhigutto.
segments.ja518:28.1: Ātaṅkinaṃ yathā kusalo bhisakko, pipāsitānaṃ rahadova sīto;
segments.ja518:28.3: Vesmaṃ yathā himasītaṭṭitānaṃ [himasisiraṭṭitānaṃ (pī.)], evampi te saraṇamahaṃ bhavāmi.
segments.ja518:29.3: Vivariya dāṭhaṃ sesi, kuto taṃ bhayamāgataṃ.
segments.ja518:31.1: Kathaṃ nu vissase tyamhi, yenāsi kalaho kato;
segments.ja518:31.3: Niccayattena ṭhātabbaṃ, so disabbhi [so disamhi (pī.)] na rajjati.
segments.ja518:32.1: Vissāsaye na ca taṃ [naṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] vissayeyya, asaṅkito saṅkito ca [asaṅkito ca saṅkito (sī. pī.)] bhaveyya;
segments.ja518:32.3: Tathā tathā viññū parakkameyya, yathā yathā bhāvaṃ paro na jaññā.
segments.ja518:33.1: Te devavaṇṇā [devavaṇṇī (pī.)] sukhumālarūpā, ubho samā sujayā [sujayo (sī. syā. pī.)] puññakhandhā [puññagandhā (pī.)];
segments.ja518:33.3: Upāgamuṃ karampiyaṃ [kādambiyaṃ (sī.), kārambiyaṃ (pī.)] acelaṃ, missībhūtā assavāhāva nāgā.
segments.ja518:34.1: Tato have paṇḍarako acelaṃ, sayamevupāgamma idaṃ avoca;
segments.ja518:34.3: Muttajjahaṃ sabbabhayātivatto, na hi [ha (pī.)] nūna tuyhaṃ manaso piyamhā.
segments.ja518:35.1: Piyo hi me āsi supaṇṇarājā, asaṃsayaṃ paṇḍarakena saccaṃ;
segments.ja518:35.3: So rāgarattova akāsimetaṃ, pāpakammaṃ [pāpaṃ kammaṃ (sī. pī.)] sampajāno na mohā.
segments.ja518:36.1: Na me piyaṃ appiyaṃ vāpi hoti, sampassato lokamimaṃ parañca;
segments.ja518:37.1: Ariyāvakāsosi anariyovāsi [anariyo cāsi (sī. pī.)], asaññato saññatasannikāso;
segments.ja518:37.3: Kaṇhābhijātikosi anariyarūpo, pāpaṃ bahuṃ duccaritaṃ acāri.
segments.ja518:38.1: Aduṭṭhassa tuvaṃ dubbhi, dubbhī [dūbhi, dūbhī (pī.)] ca pisuṇo casi;
segments.ja518:38.3: Etena saccavajjena, muddhā te phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja518:39.1: Tasmā hi mittānaṃ na dubbhitabbaṃ, mittadubbhā [mittadubbhā hi (syā.)] pāpiyo natthi añño;
segments.ja518:39.3: Āsittasatto nihato pathabyā, indassa vākyena hi saṃvaro hatoti.
